findings.passage: His priorities include supporting local jobs, workers and small businesses; backing efforts to secure the border and protect Pennsylvanians; boosting American energy independence to stop price hikes; upholding election integrity by supporting commonsense voter ID; and giving parents more control over their children’s education.
findings.note: From the About page of his official site, written in the third person. Lists support for what it calls commonsense voter ID among his priorities. No details of what the ID rule would be. Page date not shown.

findings.motion: House: Third consideration and final passage (PN 1688)
findings.note: House roll call as printed ('Bashline'), linked to Josh Bashline (district 63) via the official 2025-2026 House member roll (identity step 2026-10-31, pa-01 HB 1396 nays).
